base.purpose: The body element's own default (1rem). Almost never seen directly — every visible block overrides it with a role-specific size.

micro.purpose: Smallest mono step (0.5625rem) — rail-up, rail key, panel corner tag, plate caption, closed compartment key. Tracking varies 0.14-0.18em per call site, not yet standardized.

display.purpose: The name, once, at the top of the frame. Nothing else uses this step.

opening-line.purpose: The hero's one line of approved copy.

chapter-lede.purpose: A folder's ten-second opening line, level 1 of the depth model.

stub-voice.purpose: Italic register for copy that doesn't exist yet.

body.purpose: A chapter's running prose, rendered from markdown.

body-small.purpose: Meta-panel values, compartment names, non-stub descriptions.

kicker.purpose: Loudest standalone mono label — eyebrows, drawer heading. The descend cue (.open-line) split off this role on 2026-08-01 to read a step louder; see DESIGN.md Typography.

label.purpose: Field keys in the meta panel and at-a-glance card.

tag.purpose: Closed folder tabs, rail-number buttons, the shelf key.

compartment-name.purpose: A compartment's own name as printed on its shelf face.

shadows.name: lamination-pair
shadows.purpose: Hard-edged, zero-blur stacked sheet-edge behind the folder page. Two pairs at desktop widths, one below 880px.

shadows.name: contact
shadows.purpose: The one soft shadow in the system — tight, heavily negative-spread, standing in for the sheet resting on its own stack.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing curve in the system. Restrained, no bounce or overshoot.

motion.name: quick
motion.purpose: Hover/focus color and background transitions, and the body background crossfade that closes the one-frame-late data-accent flash.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Drives all three named motion moments: the chapter-to-chapter slide, the load-in assembly (assemble/assemble-rail), and the depth reveal's grid-template-rows tween.

components.name: Folder tab (active)
components.description: A cut tab on the folder's own edge; the currently open chapter.
components.css: .ds-tab { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #4e4a3e; background: #d4d1c4; border: 1px solid #cac6b7; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; padding: 0.6875rem 0.875rem 0.75rem; min-height: 44px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: #1c1b18; background: #dad7ca; } .ds-tab--active { background: #edebe2; color: #1c1b18; border-color: #d6d3c6; padding-right: 1.25rem; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-tab__tick { position: absolute; top: 5px; left: 0.875rem; width: 18px; height: 2px; background: #d4537e; opacity: 0; } .ds-tab--active .ds-tab__tick { opacity: 1; } .ds-tab__name { margin-left: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Rail number (current step)
components.description: A folder-index button in the persistent progress rail.
components.css: .ds-rail-num { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.75rem; color: #6a6555; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 5px; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-rail-num:hover { color: #1c1b18; background: #edebe2; } .ds-rail-num[aria-current='step'] { color: #a93a63; } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Panel (at-a-glance card)
components.description: Bordered, square meta panel with a single corner placeholder tag. Never a ruled table.
components.html:
placeholder
RoleJunior → Senior, three years

components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; background: #edebe2; border: 1px solid #d6d3c6; padding: 1.375rem 1.5rem 1.5rem; } .ds-panel__tag { position: absolute; top: -0.5625rem; right: 0.875rem; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.5625rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: #a93a63; background: #e7e5db; padding: 0 0.375rem; } .ds-panel__row + .ds-panel__row { margin-top: 0.9375rem; } .ds-panel__label { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6a6555; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } .ds-panel__val { font-family: var(--font-inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.90625rem; line-height: 1.42; color: #1c1b18; display: block; }

components.name: Pager button
components.description: Steps the open folder forward or back by one.
components.css: .ds-pager-btn { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #6a6555; border: 1px solid #beb9a8; border-radius: 5px; padding: 0.5625rem 0.875rem; min-height: 44px; background: #f3f1ea; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-pager-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { color: #1c1b18; background: #edebe2; } .ds-pager-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Depth cue
components.description: A real aria-expanded button that grows a folder's body open (~0.55s grid-template-rows tween). The dot goes gray to pink on open. Defaults closed on every folder, every time — the folder remounts on switch rather than carrying `open` over.
components.css: .ds-depth-cue { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5625rem; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #6a6555; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-depth-cue__dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6a6555; flex: none; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-depth-cue[aria-expanded='true'] .ds-depth-cue__dot { background: #d4537e; }

components.name: Shelf (drawer)
components.description: A compartment's entry in the drawer/tail. The current one carries a rose board-strip gradient. The key rests at Muted Strong and only takes Rose Ink on hover/focus/aria-current (fixed 2026-08-01 — it previously rested in Rose Ink, a live Last-2% Rule violation).
components.css: .ds-shelf { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; } .ds-shelf__face { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.375rem; flex-wrap: wrap; background: #edebe2; border: 1px solid #d6d3c6; padding: 1.1875rem 1.625rem; position: relative; z-index: 2; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-shelf:hover .ds-shelf__face { background: #f3f1ea; } .ds-shelf::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 6px; right: 6px; bottom: -9px; height: 11px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d4d1c4 0%, #cac6b7 100%); border: 1px solid #cac6b7; border-top: 0; z-index: 1; } .ds-shelf[aria-current='true']::after { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d4537e 0%, #9c2f5b 100%); border-color: #9c2f5b; } .ds-shelf__key { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #4e4a3e; min-width: 62px; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-shelf:hover .ds-shelf__key, .ds-shelf:focus-visible .ds-shelf__key, .ds-shelf[aria-current] .ds-shelf__key { color: #a93a63; } .ds-shelf__name { font-family: var(--font-fraunces, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.4375rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-shelf__sub { font-family: var(--font-inter, system-ui, sans-serif); color: #6a6555; font-size: 0.84375rem; } .ds-shelf__cta { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a93a63; }

components.name: Credit tag
components.description: The Solo/Survivor/Shared credit register, stamped rather than read as one more eyebrow line. Added 2026-08-01 — deliberately the loudest single move in the cover, since the credit register is a fact a generic portfolio can't fake.
components.css: .ds-credit { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #413e35; border: 1px solid #4e4a3e; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-credit--solo { color: #f3f1ea; background: #1c1b18; border-color: #1c1b18; }

components.name: Coming slot (inert)
components.description: A future-work placeholder (Writing, Reading). Renders as a list item, not a button — deliberately not focusable, since it leads nowhere.
components.css: .ds-slot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.25rem; border: 1px dashed #cac6b7; padding: 0.9375rem 1.625rem; margin-top: 0.75rem; min-height: 44px; } .ds-slot__key { font-family: var(--font-inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6a6555; min-width: 70px; } .ds-slot__state { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #6a6555; }

narrative.overview: The site is a drawer holding compartments, and each compartment holds folders. CCPM is one compartment, currently the only one with real folders inside it (four: 00 old system, 01 configuration, 02 planning, 03 tasks). The compartment's own name isn't settled — content currently calls it 'VPro redesign' — and naming in general is not locked. Each folder is built from the same ink-on-paper material as everything around it: no manila texture, no hinge, no illustrated cabinet. Physicality comes from construction — a folded corner with a real crease, a stacked-shadow edge that reads as lamination — not from a picture of a folder. Underneath the folder skin is a planning document, not a portfolio grid: compartments and folders load from content/ in build order, the rail is a position readout rather than a menu, and every record opens at a one-line lede with a quiet cue for more underneath. Density is asymmetric on purpose — the frame stays open and airy; a folder itself, once opened, is dense with real information. Pink is rationed to interaction: absent from every surface at rest, present only as hover color, an active-tab mark, or a current-step indicator.
keyCharacteristics: A folder built from one element's stacked, hard-edged box-shadows — no extra DOM layers, no blur standing in for a missing surface.
Two zoom levels: a folder's own tab row within an open compartment, and a drawer of compartments above that.
Pink appears only on hover, focus, an active tab, or a current-step marker — never at rest.
A variable-optical-size serif for anything read as voice, an exact mono for anything read as data, and a plain sans for running prose.
Flat, square corners are the default; radius is reserved for tab-shaped and small round controls, never for a generic content panel.

rules.name: The Last-2% Rule
rules.body: Rose is absent at rest on every surface. It exists only as the reward for hovering, focusing, or opening something.

rules.name: The Two-Jobs-One-Hue Rule
rules.body: Rose (#d4537e, 3.1:1) marks things where the bar is 3:1. Rose Ink (#a93a63, 4.5:1+) sets type where the bar is 4.5:1. Conflating the two was a real, fixed contrast bug.

rules.name: The Board-Text Exception
rules.body: Any text sitting on taupe/taupe-2 uses muted-strong, never muted — the same gray measures differently on a darker ground.

rules.name: The Optical-Size Rule
rules.body: Fraunces loads with its opsz axis on and no fixed weight array. The name and a chapter lede are genuinely different cuts from one file, not one shape scaled.

rules.name: The Unfinished Twelve Rule
rules.body: Font size in the mono label scale collapses cleanly to four reused steps. Letter-spacing does not: the same 0.5625rem size alone spans three different tracking values across five call sites, with no shared tracking token. Observed, not enforced.

rules.name: The One-Rule-Per-Gutter Rule
rules.body: Every divider in a data grid is drawn once, centered in the grid's own gap, never repeated as a border on individual cells.

rules.name: The No-Ghosts Rule
rules.body: Nothing implies a surface that doesn't exist. There is no stacked ghost folder behind the open one.

rules.name: The Radius-Is-For-Tabs Rule
rules.body: Panels stay square. Tabs and small round controls get a radius. The folder page is the one exception, square only where it joins the tab row.

dos: Do separate every section by whitespace scale alone, never a full-width rule.
Do render the meta panel and the at-a-glance card as bordered, square panels with tight label/value stacking, never a ruled table.
Do keep a stub/placeholder tag to one per block, in the corner, in Rose Ink — never repeated inline before every field.
Do keep the rail sticky and persistent at every viewport.
Do build any future depth from stacked, opaque, near-zero-blur box-shadows before reaching for extra DOM layers or a soft drop-shadow.
Do use rose for marks and rose-ink for type — never the reverse.
Do load Fraunces with its opsz axis active, no fixed weight list.
Do keep a folder tab's full name in the accessible name at all times, even when visually clipped to a number.

Do gate a one-time load-in animation (assemble, assemble-rail) to a real first paint (data-boot / useIsFirstBoot), never to a component's own mount — in a route-per-page app, a client-side navigation mounts a 'fresh' rail on every click.
donts: Don't use a full-width horizontal rule as a section or chapter divider.
Don't render a field list as a table with a hairline under every row.
Don't add fake stacked ghost folders behind the open one, or escalate drop-shadow blur to fake extra depth.
Don't render the folder in photoreal manila texture or add literal cabinet chrome.
Don't let rose appear anywhere at rest.
Don't dim a 'coming' label with text-opacity alone — a prior opacity-only attempt measured 2.06:1 and failed AA.
Don't assume Page keeps its open state across a folder switch — it's remounted specifically so depth reverts to closed every time.
Don't let a resting text color resolve to Rose Ink outside hover/focus/active-current — the shelf key shipped this exact violation and was corrected 2026-08-01.
